description: This file contains functions for extracting and processing message text, including handling cached extraction, thinking tags, and formatting reasoning in markdown. It is specific to chat message processing within the project.

methods.name: processMessageText
methods.description: Processes message text based on role, stripping inbound metadata or thinking tags as appropriate.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Extracts and processes raw message text based on message role.

methods.name: extractTextCached
methods.description: Returns cached extracted text if available, otherwise extracts and caches it.

methods.name: extractThinking
methods.description: Extracts 'thinking' content from message, including legacy <think> tags.

methods.name: extractThinkingCached
methods.description: Returns cached thinking content if available, otherwise extracts and caches it.

methods.name: extractRawText
methods.description: Extracts raw text content from message, handling string and array formats.

methods.name: formatReasoningMarkdown
methods.description: Formats reasoning text into markdown with emphasis.
